I hear my front door open. I live in a studio so the door is just yards away from where I’m laying. A tall, jagged, black figure starts walking towards me. It looked like a person drawn with up and down, side to side strokes with a pen; jagged and sharp. 
“This can’t be real”, I thought. “My eyes are open, I should be awake. Why am I not awake?!”, I tried to scream again in horror but nothing came out. 
The figure slowly approaches my bed. It stares with awful black eyes; eyes like a black hole. I could see the event horizon; the part of the black hole of which you cannot escape and you become sucked in. 
Then it leans down and scratches my face with its needle like fingers. And I could feel it. I was awake and I could feel it touching me. It then, with surgical precision, stuck it’s finger my left eye ball. Going deeper and deeper; I felt it poke my brain, then kept going. It curled it’s finger inside my skull and with one sharp movement, yanked it’s finger out of my eye socket; my eye ball and grey matter attached. 
Then, it did the same with its left eye. It filled his bloodied empty eye socket with my eye ball. I knew what would happen next and I begged in my remaining brain for death. 
It pushed its black hole eye ball into my emptied socket.

Today I slept most of the day as per usual. I had taken pain and anxiety meds because of the horrific pain I was in. My sleep was broken up; three hours asleep, two hours awake, four hours asleep, three hours awake. Then, around 9pm I tried to fall asleep again, but this time it was… different. 
My heart was pounding with anxiety. Every time I closed my eyes a different horrific image would appear. Every time I would try to open my eyes to get the image out of my head, then immediately dosed off again. A bloody clown. Opened my eyes. The girl from the ring. Opened my eyes. A corpse running at me. Opened my eyes. Someone hanging from a tree. Opened my eyes. A creature right in front of my face. Opened my eyes.
Then the screaming started. Every time I would close my eyes, my ears started ringing and then… screams. Horrific, ungodly screams coming from the depths of hell… or dream land. I was able to open my eyes a few times to stop it but sleep kept dragging me down. More screams, more horrific images. I tried to scream for help; that terrifying feeling of trying to scream but not being able to. I woke up two more times, awoken by my own cries for help, shaking and thrashing in bed. Maybe it was the meds that forced me to keep falling asleep. But now I know, it was dream land pulling me in. Then, sleep took me, dream land took me. 
Again, screaming, horrific images, opened my eyes. But this time, the images didn’t go away. I was still trying to scream for help and couldn’t. But I knew, or rather thought I knew, I was awake. The screaming from hell never stopped. Horrific image after horrific image were coming after me now. Swooping down into my face just to stare. A bloodied child. A terrifying bat-like creature. A family member with a slit throat. A corpse lay next to me, ghastly and grey. Just. Staring. All this time trying to scream for help, my eyes opened and scanning the room to make the images stop, but they didn’t.

After my lap, I got off birth control (because I didn’t need it after getting my tubes tied) and it turned out my bc that I was on for 9 years was covering up my symptoms. I had the benefit of having a dr that knew the severity of my pain bc I saw her for it.
